data.title: Unit 2 : The Animal World
Types of Animals
data.text: The ear has three of the smallest bones in the human body.
The outer ear collects sound as it passes by the ear.
The sound then makes its way into the middle ear and hits the eardrum.
The eardrum turns the sound into vibrations. These vibrations move into the inner ear.
